items.author: Musk
items.text: After $86 billion IPO, SpaceX to borrow $20 billion
items.summary_cn: SpaceX 在860亿美元IPO后拟再举债200亿美元，规模与杠杆信号均偏积极/激进，直接影响 SPCH 估值预期。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's SpaceX Could Acquire T-Mobile In Wireless Push, Says Analyst
items.summary_cn: 分析师称 SpaceX 可能收购 T-Mobile 拓展无线业务；如成行将利好 SPCH，并带来 TMUS 这一 new_idea（被收购方）。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk-connected company buys land, water infrastructure before Grimes County’s SpaceX tax vote
items.summary_cn: Musk 关联公司在 SpaceX 税收投票前抢购 Grimes County 土地与水利基建，利好 SPCH（2x SpaceX ETF）所跟踪的 SpaceX 估值。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX's drop off sees Elon Musk's net worth fall $240 billion—roughly the same value as computing giant IBM
items.summary_cn: SpaceX 估值大幅回调致 Musk 净资产蒸发约2400亿美元，SPCH（2x SpaceX ETF）跟踪标的承压。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk's SpaceX targets US consumers with Starlink mobile service push, FT reports
items.summary_cn: SpaceX 旗下 Starlink 推进面向美国消费者的卫星移动通信服务，直接利好 SPCH（2x SpaceX ETF）。

items.author: Musk
items.text: 'The cult of Elon': SpaceX investors grapple with volatility amid big swings
items.summary_cn: SpaceX 投资人面对剧烈估值波动，凸显二级/私募市场对 SpaceX 的高波动预期，与 SPCH 跟踪标的直接相关。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk loses trillionaire status as SpaceX and Tesla stock drops
items.summary_cn: Musk 因 Tesla 与 SpaceX 股价下跌失去万亿富翁头衔，反映 Musk 系资产承压；间接影响 SPCH 情绪。

items.author: Musk
items.text: In Europe, Tesla Sales Are Rising Despite Views on Elon Musk
items.summary_cn: Tesla 在欧洲销量逆势上升，Musk 个人形象争议未拖累销售，对 TSLA 偏多信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: RT @realDonaldTrumpWow! The Senate just changed its vote on Iran from 50-48 against, to 50-47 for. Rand Paul and Bill Cassidy changed. Thank you to Leader John Thune, Lindsey Graham, Bernie Moreno, and all. This vote puts Iran on notice! President DJT
items.summary_cn: 美参议院对伊朗立场转鹰（50-47支持），地缘紧张升级，利多国防/军工与能源板块。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Wow! The Senate just changed its vote on Iran from 50-48 against, to 50-47 for. Rand Paul and Bill Cassidy changed. Thank you to Leader John Thune, Lindsey Graham, Bernie Moreno, and all. This vote puts Iran on notice! President DJT
items.summary_cn: 与第7条同一事件重复报道，保留信息量最高的一条即可，本条可忽略。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The Communists are finally making their move. I’ve been waiting and preparing for this for a long time. It’s easy to be a Communist — All you have to do is say, “I’ll give you everything,” but that means you’re taking it away from others that have earned it. Over thousands of years, that Ideology has not worked once. The game is on. Enjoy watching! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump 称'共产主义者在行动'，意识形态口水，间接暗示对国内政策/选举格局的强硬立场，对市场影响有限但反映政治氛围。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The two major earthquakes that just hit the great people of Venezuela are both massive in scale and have left a devastating number of deaths. The U.S.A. stands ready, willing, and able to help! I have instructed all agencies of our government to get ready to move quickly. We will be there for our new and great friends. Early reports are not good!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: 委内瑞拉大地震，美国准备援助；委内瑞拉是重要产油国，灾后局势可能扰动油价。
